Container.Name: HCM
Container.Overview:
Enterprise Human Capital Management (HCM) platform for 10,000+ employees — a self-hosted alternative in the class of Workday / BambooHR / SAP SuccessFactors.
  • Core HR, employee self-service, real-time org charts
  • Time & attendance (timeclock punches, shift scheduling incl. 12h 2-2-3 crews, leave/absence)
  • Payroll + tax, recruiting/ATS, performance/360, LMS with Coursera-style course content, benefits, surveys & AI assistant
  • A universal import engine to onboard data from other HCM vendors
  • Argon2id password hashing + per-session TOTP MFA, row-level audit/compliance
  • REST API with scoped bearer tokens
  • Multi-language: EN / ES / DE / FR / ZH
Requires PostgreSQL 16. Install a Postgres container (e.g. the Postgres template) and point POSTGRES_HOST at it with matching credentials. On a shared docker network use the container name; on bridge use its IP. First-run: open the web UI, log in, then create your admin from the container console (docker exec -it HCM python manage.py createsuperuser) and seed reference data (python manage.py seed_dev seed_shifts seed_positions to jump-start org, shifts, and job titles).
  • GitHub repo

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the HCM web UI.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Persistent storage for uploaded documents and media.

Config.Name: DB Host
Config.Description: Hostname/IP of your PostgreSQL 16 container. On a shared network use the container name; on bridge use its IP.

Config.Name: DB Password
Config.Description: PostgreSQL password (must match your DB container).

Config.Name: Django Secret Key
Config.Description: Django SECRET_KEY - use a long random string and keep it stable.

Config.Name: Debug
Config.Description: Set to false in production (never true on the LAN-facing container).

Config.Name: Allowed Hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated hostnames/IPs (your Unraid host + LAN IP/domain) Django will serve.

Config.Name: MFA Encryption Key
Config.Description: Fernet key used to encrypt TOTP secrets at rest (44-char urlsafe-base64). Generate with: python -c "from cryptography.fernet import Fernet;print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())"
